subject: Setting and/or getting grid of hyperparameter values used in the numerical integration.

messages.author: 2f6c5eed34f4bc17
messages.subject: Setting and/or getting grid of hyperparameter values used in the numerical integration.
parts:
Hello! I am fitting a simple RW2 model:

inlamodel <- inla(
    y ~ f(x,model = "rw2"),
    data = ds,
    family = "poisson",
    control.inla = list(strategy = "gaussian",int.strategy = "grid")
)

and for benchmarking purposes, I was wondering if it is possible to:

1) Set my own grid of theta (log precision of the RW2) values for use in the numerical integration, avoiding the hyperparameter posterior optimization step, and/or
2) Return the grid of theta values actually used by INLA.

Thank you!

Alex

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Setting and/or getting grid of hyperparameter values used in the numerical integration.
parts:
The answer is yes, and yes.

browseVignettes(package="INLA")

and you see 'define your own integration points' or similar (cannot
recall the title).

In the code, you also see result$joint.hyper is the matrix of the
points used, if that is required.

H
